name: JC
source: A college student, sophomore. She's the customer service and checkout at Marshmallow Tree. Nicknamed JC, but nobody knows her real name. On the outside looks like a gyaru and talks a lot, but is unexpectedly a person who does her job decently. Her communication skill is good, but can't handle kids.
